basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define and test the marketplace blueprint and the plan for a pilot in one region.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Do we approve the blueprint and move to a pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version in one region and test it against the repeat-order and distributor criteria.

gate.label: Scale-up decision
gate.decision: Do we take the scale-up business case into the 2027 budget round?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about contractors, distributors and the portal must hold for the marketplace to work?
activities: Frame hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Review documents on the existing B2B ordering portal
Hold working sessions with the CEO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Contractor demand
workstreams.answers: What do small and mid-size contractors need, and what would make them order from MetalCo online?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors
Analyze ordering data from the B2B portal and warehouses
Test the hypotheses with contractors in both countries

workstreams.name: Distributor relationships
workstreams.answers: How would direct online sales affect the regional distributors, and what keeps them selling with MetalCo?
activities: Interview regional distributors and council members
Review distributor contracts and sales documents
Map where marketplace and distributor sales could overlap

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What does the marketplace blueprint look like, and what will the pilot in one region test?
activities: Draft the marketplace blueprint with tested hypotheses
Define the pilot scope in one region
Prepare the pilot go/no-go pack with the steering group

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and results
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs define pilot success, and how do the pilot results compare with them?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO, Head of Sales and council
Track repeat orders and distributor contracts against KPIs
Meet the distributors council to review pilot progress

workstreams.name: Pilot target contractors
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region should be the first to use the marketplace?
activities: Analyze contractor accounts in the pilot region
Interview contractors about how they buy materials today

workstreams.name: Pilot marketplace build
workstreams.answers: Is the first marketplace version ready to launch, and how does it perform with pilot contractors?
activities: Build the marketplace first version for the pilot region
Prepare launch readiness with the Head of Sales
Launch to a small group of contractors

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: Does the pilot support scaling the marketplace, and what would the plan and roadmap be?
activities: Analyze pilot results against the agreed KPIs
Draft the scale-up business case
Draft the implementation plan and roadmap

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Pilot plan and go/no-go decision pack
Pilot KPIs agreed with key stakeholders
Pilot results against the agreed KPIs
First contractor target group in the pilot region
Launch readiness plan for the pilot marketplace
First marketplace version launched to a small group
Outline of the scale-up business case
Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align scope, plan and ways of working
events.decision: Confirm the scope and the question the engagement answers?
agenda: Present the plan of work and the steering meetings
Align on the governing question and the success criteria
Confirm access to people and data for interviews

events.label: Workshop: first findings
events.decision: Confirm the direction for the blueprint and the pilot plan?
agenda: Present contractor demand and distributor impact findings
Discuss risks to the regional distributor relationships
Decide the direction for the blueprint and the pilot plan

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether the pilot goes ahead
events.decision: Do we approve the blueprint and move to a pilot in one region?
agenda: Present the marketplace blueprint and the pilot plan
Review open risks for distributors and the pilot region
Decide on the go/no-go for the pilot

events.label: Workshop 1: launch readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before anything goes live
events.decision: Is the pilot ready to launch to the first group of contractors?
agenda: Present the pilot KPIs, target contractors and launch readiness
Discuss how distributors are kept informed before launch
Confirm that the launch can go ahead

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot signals
events.purpose: Review pilot signals and scale-up outline
events.decision: Do we agree the scope of the scale-up business case?
agenda: Present the launched version and the first pilot signals
Review the outline of the scale-up business case
Discuss distributor feedback and open risks

events.label: Scale-up decision
events.purpose: Decide on the scale-up of the marketplace
events.decision: Do we take the scale-up business case into the 2027 budget round?
agenda: Present the pilot results against the KPIs
Review the business case, implementation plan and roadmap
Decide whether to take the scale-up forward

architect_notes: The 20-week length is stated; the split into 8 weeks of Design and 12 of Pilot is my estimate, to be confirmed before quoting.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports under the Construction Products Regulation. Confirm whether it is in scope.
The rollout after the pilot is not in these phases; the plan ends with a scale-up business case and a scale-up decision.
Contractors in Portugal and Spain are studied in Design, but the pilot tests one region only; confirm whether the rest needs its own test.
I dropped the archetype's hires deliverable because the brief mentions no hiring; confirm whether the pilot needs staffing.
